title: Song - O Come, All Ye Faithful
subtitle: Arrangement: the tune with left-hand block chords
trains: A hymn tune with a one-beat pickup over block chords (G, C, D) in the left, one chord per bar.

provenance.author: claude-sonnet-5
provenance.basedOn: mutopia-1220-adeste-fideles: "Adeste Fideles" (hymn tune, "O Come, All Ye Faithful"), J. F. Wade, SATB; the tune is in the Soprano (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1220)
provenance.note: Melody from www.cyberhymnal.org (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1220), public domain; left-hand chords our own (CC0)

departures: Left-hand block chords are our own (CC0).
